nodes.text: A clash occurred among fishermen in Chinnammuttam, Kanyakumari district.

A clash occurred between fishermen in Chinnammuttam, Kanyakumari, after some boats left early, leading to a protest and confrontation. Police intervened to prevent further violence. The incident highlighted regulatory issues in fishing operations.
